declared_cases.note: Serious = at least one section carries a maximum sentence of 5+ years. None of the 14 pending cases qualify: most are preventive proceedings under CrPC Section 151, and the remainder carry IPC sections such as 143, 341, 149, 269, 270, 271, 290 and 188 (unlawful assembly and public-health related offences), none of which reach the 5-year threshold. Charges are not framed in any case; zero convictions.
